implemented_requirements.evidence: The repository contains only a board utility module; no puzzle design, strands, or game logic is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide multiple strands of text for the player to combine
implemented_requirements.evidence: No data structures or definitions of strands appear in the provided file.
The code only defines cell parsing and adjacency helpers; there is no verification of word or phrase formation.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Confirm completion once all strands are correctly merged
implemented_requirements.evidence: No completion detection or state‑tracking logic is present.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Offer feedback on valid merges (similar to NYT Strands)
implemented_requirements.evidence: No feedback or messaging functionality is implemented.

critical_issues: Missing core game logic: no representation of strands, board state, or merge operations.
No user‑interaction loop or API to accept merges and provide feedback.
Absence of any validation of word/phrase correctness; only generic cell utilities are present.
No mechanism to determine or signal puzzle completion.
judge.summary: The submitted file only provides generic board utilities (cell parsing, naming, adjacency). It does not implement any of the required features for the 'Strands' word‑segmentation puzzle, such as defining strands, merging logic, validation, completion detection, or feedback. Consequently, the solution fails to meet the benchmark requirements.
